description:
List bounties this BTC address has submitted to. Defaults to the current wallet's bc1q address.

Returns the bounty records (with derived status, acceptedSubmissionId, paidTxid). Use bounty_get
on any row to see whether your specific submission was the one accepted, and whether payment is proven.

By default returns up to 50 active (non-terminal) bounties. Pass include_terminal=true for a combined view across all states.

No authentication required.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

btc_address.description: BTC address to query. Omit to use the current wallet's bc1q address.

include_terminal.description: If true, fetches all states in parallel and returns a combined view.

name: bounty_my_submissions
